existing_updates.title: Stingray Soffit Speaker Kit
existing_updates.description:
Stingray Soffit Speaker Kit

The Stingray Soffit Speaker Kit lets installers swap ugly conventional speakers for the high-performance Stingray 8 or Stingray 83 in a clean, flush-mounted soffit application. Each kit ships with an integrated back box, dedicated mounting hardware and a router template so the cutout is precise the first time, producing a permanent fixture that survives the elements without compromising aesthetics.

  • Choice of Stingray 8 (2-way, 45 Hz - 18 kHz) or Stingray 83 (3-way, 40 Hz - 20 kHz) drivers
  • 160 watts RMS, 83 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion
  • FidelityGlass front face accepts paint or vinyl wrap to match the soffit
  • IP-68 rated for rain, snow, sleet, hail, sun and dust

Stealth's direct-coupled motor and acoustic-lever technology energize the FidelityGlass radiating surface for crisp highs and impactful bass once installed flush under any eave or overhang.

existing_updates.title: SLR8g
existing_updates.description:
SLR8g Dual-Channel Invisible Speaker

The SLR8g is a dual-channel, full-range invisible speaker most popularly deployed in distributed audio systems because it can reproduce both stereo channels from a single panel. After installation the rigid frame and paintable diaphragm vanish into the wall or ceiling, leaving only sound.

  • Two 1-1/8 in (30 mm) neodymium high-frequency motors
  • One 8 in woofer with 1-1/2 in voice coil and 20 oz ceramic magnet
  • 120 watts RMS capacity, 60 watts minimum recommended
  • 82 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 170 degrees vertical and horizontal dispersion
  • 20-year limited warranty

Ideal for hallways, foyers and other narrow rooms where running a true stereo pair is impractical, the SLR8g delivers the broad coverage and clean wall finish that make Stealth's LineaResponse series a long-running custom-install staple.

existing_updates.title: Stingray 8
existing_updates.description:
Stingray 8 Outdoor Loudspeaker

The Stingray 8 is a 2-way full-range outdoor loudspeaker built around an 8 in woofer and a 1-1/8 in neodymium high-frequency driver. Stealth's direct-coupled motor and acoustic-lever architecture drive the FidelityGlass face to produce broad coverage and weather-proof bass for residential and commercial outdoor systems.

  • 2-way passive crossover, 8 in woofer with 1-1/2 in voice coil
  • 45 Hz to 18 kHz frequency response, 160 watts RMS
  • 83 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion
  • IP-68 environmental rating; two self-resetting protection circuits

The sealed FidelityGlass diaphragm blocks intrusion of moisture and dust, allowing the Stingray 8 to survive rain, snow, sleet, hail, sun and dust between 0 and 150 deg F while maintaining studio-grade audio fidelity in patios, pools, marine environments and landscape installs.

existing_updates.title: LRX-85
existing_updates.description:
LRX-85 Premium 3-Way Invisible Speaker System

The LRX-85 is a premium, 3-way, two-panel invisible loudspeaker system that delivers a complete full-range solution without requiring bass-limiting filters or external subwoofers. Seven precision drivers split between a high-mid panel and a low-frequency panel produce up to 105 dB output, ideal for home theater LCR duty, distributed audio and critical-listening rooms where visible speakers are not acceptable.

  • 3-way, two-panel architecture (HM + LF)
  • One 1 in neodymium HF, four 1-1/8 in neodymium MR motors
  • Two 8 in low-profile woofers
  • 35 Hz to 20 kHz frequency response, 300 watts RMS capacity
  • 84 dB sensitivity, 8 ohm nominal impedance
  • 170 degrees horizontal and vertical dispersion
  • Three independent self-resetting protection circuits

Both panels finish flush to the wallboard and accept paint or light finish to disappear entirely once installed.

existing_updates.description:
Stingray Ground Stake (SRGSTK)

The SRGSTK Ground Stake is a purpose-built mounting accessory for Stealth Acoustics' Stingray series outdoor loudspeakers. With an aluminum finish to resist corrosion, the stake plants directly into soft ground so Stingray speakers can be positioned freely throughout landscape, garden and poolside installations without requiring permanent structures or wall mounts.

  • Aluminum finish for outdoor durability
  • Recommended for landscape and ground-based placement
  • Allows flexible speaker positioning around lawns, planters and pool decks
  • Pairs with the U-Bracket (SRUB) for situations requiring extra stability

The Ground Stake keeps Stingray speakers upright and aimed correctly in soft soil applications, complementing the speakers' IP-68 environmental rating for a fully weather-proof outdoor audio solution.

existing_updates.title: SA2400-MKII
existing_updates.description:
SA2400-MKII High-Current DSP Amplifier

The SA2400-MKII is a 2-rack-unit high-current amplifier with built-in DSP, engineered to drive Stealth invisible speakers, subwoofers and full home-theater systems. It delivers 310 watts per channel into 8 ohm and 450 watts per channel into 4 ohm with vanishingly low distortion, providing the clean headroom required to extract every drop of performance from Stealth's flat-diaphragm loudspeakers.

  • 310 W / channel into 8 ohm, 450 W / channel into 4 ohm
  • 20 Hz to 50 kHz frequency response (+1 / -3 dB)
  • Total Harmonic Distortion below 0.05% at 460 W / 4 ohm
  • Signal-to-noise ratio greater than 105 dB (A-weighted)
  • Crosstalk greater than 85 dB; 36 dB maximum voltage gain into 8 ohm
  • 2 RU rack-mount chassis, 19 in W x 15-3/4 in D x 3-1/2 in H

Onboard DSP allows the installer to tailor crossovers, EQ and protection for any Stealth speaker pairing in residential or commercial deployments.

new_products.title: SPT Megalith
new_products.description:
Stealth Patio Theater Megalith

The SPT Megalith is a fixed-position outdoor LED video display system engineered for year-round entertainment in any weather. The customizable, weatherproof platform installs as a free-standing display, wall-mounted or ceiling-hung unit and can be configured with an optional integrated 3.1 sound bar driven by Stealth's Stingray outdoor speaker technology.

  • Fixed-position LED screen with 4,000 cd/m2 brightness
  • P3 or P4 resolutions from 101 in to 339 in diagonal
  • Wall-mount or free-standing installation
  • Optional 3.1 cabinet-mounted sound bar
  • 220-240 VAC, 2 to 6 x 20 A circuits depending on configuration
  • Ambient light sensor; weatherproof modular construction
  • Compatible with major third-party home automation systems

The Megalith is the largest member of the Stealth Patio Theater family, ideal for commercial venues, large estates and outdoor cinema applications.

new_products.title: BX Back Box
new_products.description:
BX MDF Back Box

The BX is an MDF back box engineered to improve sound isolation and speaker performance when retrofitting or new-constructing Stealth invisible speakers in walls or ceilings without plenum requirements. Each enclosure ships pre-assembled and pre-painted with Roxul insulation and a terminal cup with speaker-wire pigtails, ready to attach to the speaker prior to installation.

  • Pre-assembled, pre-painted MDF construction
  • Roxul insulation pre-installed
  • Terminal cup with speaker-wire pigtails included
  • Five sizes: BX-30, BX-22, BX-22SLR, BX-12-85, BX-12
  • Compatible with legacy LineaResponse speakers (not LineaRadiance)

Use the BX in residential settings where a sealed, sound-isolating enclosure is desired but plenum-rated metal back boxes are not required.

new_products.title: MBX Metal Back Box
new_products.description:
MBX UL-Rated Metal Back Box

The MBX is a UL-listed, 1.1 mm thick metal enclosure for installing Stealth invisible speakers in walls or ceilings where metal protection is required or sound transfer between adjacent rooms must be minimized. At 3-1/2 in deep, it fits standard 2x4 stud bays and 16 in on-center stud spacing, and ships fully assembled.

  • UL listed, 1.1 mm metal construction
  • Fully assembled at shipment
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in or 3/4 in conduit on top and bottom
  • Includes insulation, screws and 3/4 in x 1-1/2 in metal mounting angles
  • Five sizes covering LineaRadiance and LineaResponse speakers

The MBX is the right choice for plenum spaces, fire-code installations and commercial applications.

new_products.title: MBA Metal Back Box (Adjustable)
new_products.description:
MBA Adjustable UL-Listed Metal Back Box

The MBA is a versatile, UL-listed adjustable metal back box for installations where stud spacing is non-standard, framing members are tighter than 16 in on center, or metal studs and suspended ceilings are in play. Each enclosure ships unassembled so installers can configure it on-site for the exact application.

  • 1.1 mm thick metal construction, UL listed
  • Adjustable width from 9-3/4 in to 14-1/2 in
  • Ships unassembled for site-built configuration
  • Includes screws, Dynamat adhesive insulation, and 3/4 in x 1-1/2 in metal mounting angles
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in and 3/4 in conduit
  • Three sizes covering LineaRadiance and LineaResponse speakers

The MBA is the most flexible Stealth back box, ideal for retrofits and commercial installs with unpredictable framing.

new_products.title: MBC Metal Back Box (Masonry)
new_products.description:
MBC Masonry Metal Back Box

The MBC is a wood-lined metal back box designed for installing Stealth invisible speakers into masonry, hat channel or other support structures. It can be installed before masonry work is completed or fitted into existing masonry. The 1.2 mm metal shell protects the speaker from surrounding masonry while the 3/4 in plywood liner provides secure mounting on all four edges.

  • 1.2 mm metal construction with 3/4 in plywood liner on all four edges
  • Fully assembled at shipment
  • Knockouts for 1/2 in conduit and loom clamps on top and bottom
  • Includes light insulation and screw package
  • Five sizes covering current and legacy Stealth invisible speakers

Use the MBC anywhere a Stealth speaker must integrate with concrete, brick, block or other masonry construction.

new_products.title: PlaceSavers
new_products.description:
PlaceSavers Pre-Installation Brackets

PlaceSavers are temporary place-holders for new construction that allow Stealth invisible speakers to be installed in a later phase of the project while keeping the exact mounting location free of drywall. They protect the speaker positions from harsh construction conditions and are sold in reusable packs of six.

  • Reusable pre-installation brackets, six per pack
  • Five sizes matching every current Stealth invisible speaker
  • Keep speaker positions free of drywall and protected during construction
  • Allow late-phase speaker installation without re-cutting

PlaceSavers are essential on every new-construction project where Stealth speakers will be installed late in the build cycle.

new_products.title: Shim Kit
new_products.description:
Stealth Acoustics Shim Kit

The Shim Kit allows installers to shim the face of a Stealth invisible speaker panel further out from the framing depending on the chosen finishing method. Each kit contains a bundle of 25 shims of two thicknesses for fine adjustment in any drywall or finishing scenario.

  • Two shim thicknesses: 1/16 in (1.6 mm) and 1/8 in (3.2 mm)
  • 25 shims of each thickness per bundle
  • Compatible with the full Stealth Acoustics invisible speaker line
  • Critical for matching panel face to finished wall surface

The Shim Kit is a low-cost accessory that pays for itself the first time a finished wall thickness varies from spec.

new_products.title: Stingray U-Bracket (SRUB)
new_products.description:
Stingray U-Bracket (SRUB)

The SRUB is a heavy-duty U-bracket designed for Stealth Acoustics Stingray outdoor speakers. Constructed from powder-coated aluminum and offered in matching white or black finishes, it provides the extra stability required when Stingray speakers are mounted to walls, soffits, posts or other vertical structures.

  • Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum construction
  • Available in white or black to match Stingray speakers
  • Provides enhanced mounting stability versus the basic mount
  • Compatible with the full Stingray outdoor speaker series
  • Pairs with the Ground Stake (SRGSTK) for landscape installs

Specify the SRUB whenever extra mechanical rigidity or aiming control is needed for outdoor Stingray installations.
